correctness.rationale: Exactly 24 admissible Fano perfect matchings are independently enumerated. Equality of unsigned permanent and determinant forces common permutation parity. Vertex sign switching reduces all 2^21 Walsh characters to 256 signed 7×7 matrices. Across all 256, direct signed matching sums, DP signed permanents and Bareiss integer determinants agree with histogram (-8:45,0:168,8:42,24:1). Exact direct and fast inverse Walsh transforms agree at each reduced coordinate with kernel histogram (-8:77,0:108,8:42,16:28,88:1). Rank, nullity and norm 93/16 follow by explicit arithmetic. Translation averaging proves unrestricted sharpness for both endpoints. No infinite conclusion claimed.

value.rationale: The exact signal space of the natural 24-element Heawood perfect-matching incidence codebook and the optimal endpoint amplification quantify precise information loss and recovery, not merely the known matching count. Its rigid signed determinant values, 720896-dimensional recoverable range and rational 93/16 optimal projection norm are natural, reproducible graph Fourier invariants with a clear inverse-problem interpretation.
